metas.name: Sicario
metas.description: An idealistic FBI agent is enlisted by a government task force to aid in the escalating war against drugs at the border area between the U.S. and Mexico.

metas.name: Sicario: Day of the Soldado
metas.description: Agent Matt Graver teams up with operative Alejandro Gillick to prevent Mexican drug cartels from smuggling terrorists across the United States border.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: An FBI agent teams with the town's veteran game tracker to investigate a murder that occurred on a Native American reservation.

metas.name: Those Who Wish Me Dead
metas.description: A young boy finds himself pursued by two assassins in the Montana wilderness, with a survival expert determined to protect him, and a forest fire threatening to consume them all.

metas.name: Tom Clancy's Without Remorse
metas.description: An elite Navy SEAL uncovers an international conspiracy while seeking justice for the murder of his pregnant wife.

metas.name: Finestkind
metas.description: Two brothers from opposite sides of the tracks are reunited as adults. Desperate circumstances force them into a deal with an organized crime syndicate in Boston, and a young woman gets caught in the middle.

metas.name: F.A.S.T. (upcoming)
metas.description: ⏳ Expected release: 2027-04-22. A former special forces commando, down on his luck after returning Stateside, is recruited by the DEA to lead a covert black ops team to take down CIA-protected drug dealers.

metas.name: Sicario: Capos (upcoming)
metas.description: ⏳ Not yet released — status: Rumored. The third installment in the Sicario trilogy set to be released in 2028.

metas.name: Vile
metas.description: A group of people awaken to find themselves prisoners in a mysterious house with no means of escape. They are each outfitted with electronic devices attached to the base of their skulls. The chemicals that the brain produces when in pain are collected by the devices, and when it collects a predetermined amount, the doors will be opened. In order to escape, they must hurt themselves and each other.

metas.name: Disorder (upcoming)
metas.description: ⏳ Not yet released — status: Rumored. A war veteran is hired to protect the family of a wealthy businessman.
